evidence.quote: It is unknown whether ZEPBOUND causes thyroid C-cell tumors, including MTC, in humans as human relevance of tirzepatide-induced rodent thyroid C-cell tumors has not been determined.
Significantly elevated serum calcitonin values may indicate MTC and patients with MTC usually have calcitonin values >50 ng/L.

Possible thyroid tumors, including cancer. Tell your healthcare provider if you get a lump or swelling in your neck, hoarseness, trouble swallowing, or shortness of breath. These may be symptoms of thyroid cancer.

response.reasoning: The claim states that ZEPBOUND does not cause thyroid cancer, but the label excerpts mention the risk of thyroid C-cell tumors, including medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC), in patients treated with ZEPBOUND. The excerpts also mention that it is unknown whether ZEPBOUND causes thyroid C-cell tumors in humans, but the risk is considered to be a potential concern.
